database_summary: Small bowling/tournament schema. Core entities: Bowlers, Teams, Tournaments, Tourney_Matches (matches within tournaments), Match_Games (individual games within a match) and Bowler_Scores (per-bowler score per game). Several *_Archive tables mirror live tables but are empty in the profile. WAZips is a static zip→city/state lookup. The schema mixes descriptive attributes (Bowlers, Teams), events/measurements (Bowler_Scores, Match_Games, Tourney_Matches), and archives for historical copies. GameNumber is limited to 3 (three-game matches).

accepted.name: bowler_game_scores
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID,
  bs.RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore,
  bs.WonGame,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerMiddleInit,
  b.TeamID,
  mg.WinningTeamID
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
LEFT JOIN Bowlers AS b
  ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
LEFT JOIN Match_Games AS mg
  ON bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID
  AND bs.GameNumber = mg.GameNumber
accepted.description: One row per bowler-game combining Bowler_Scores with Bowler and Match_Game metadata. Useful for analyses that need per-game bowler details together with team and match-level info. | Use for: compare bowler RawScore vs HandiCapScore per game; list bowler game results with team and winning-team flag; aggregate bowler performance across matches/games

accepted.name: tourney_match_details
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  tm.MatchID,
  tm.TourneyID,
  t.TourneyDate,
  t.TourneyLocation,
  tm.Lanes,
  tm.OddLaneTeamID,
  odd.TeamName AS TeamName_OddLaneTeamID,
  tm.EvenLaneTeamID,
  even.TeamName AS TeamName_EvenLaneTeamID
FROM Tourney_Matches AS tm
LEFT JOIN Tournaments AS t
  ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
LEFT JOIN Teams AS odd
  ON tm.OddLaneTeamID = odd.TeamID
LEFT JOIN Teams AS even
  ON tm.EvenLaneTeamID = even.TeamID
accepted.description: One row per Tourney_Matches.MatchID combining match, tournament, and team descriptive info. Useful for match-level reports including tournament date/location and team names. | Use for: list matches for a tournament with team names and lanes; join match-level results to tournament dates/locations; filter matches by team or location

accepted.name: bowler_season_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.BowlerID,
  COUNT(*) AS games_played,
  SUM(bs.RawScore) AS total_raw_score,
  SUM(bs.HandiCapScore) AS total_handicap_score,
  ROUND(AVG(bs.RawScore), 2) AS average_raw_score
FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
GROUP BY bs.BowlerID
accepted.description: Aggregated per-bowler summary computed from Bowler_Scores: total RawScore, total HandiCapScore, games_played, average_raw_score. Useful as a per-bowler season/match summary for ranking or trend calculations. | Use for: who has the highest average or total pins; compare bowlers by games played and average; filter bowlers with at least N games (N applied by query)

accepted.name: team_match_wins
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(mg.WinningTeamID, b.TeamID) AS TeamID,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mg.WinningTeamID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS games_won_by_match_games_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bs.WonGame = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wongame_flags_count
FROM Match_Games AS mg
LEFT JOIN Bowler_Scores AS bs
  ON mg.MatchID = bs.MatchID
  AND mg.GameNumber = bs.GameNumber
LEFT JOIN Bowlers AS b
  ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
GROUP BY COALESCE(mg.WinningTeamID, b.TeamID)
accepted.description: Per-team aggregated wins at the (MatchID, GameNumber) level using Match_Games.WinningTeamID and Bowler_Scores WonGame flag where available. Produces counts of games won (from Match_Games) and counts of bowler won-game flags, enabling cross-checks between team-level winners and per-bowler Win flags. | Use for: compare team wins as recorded in Match_Games vs bowler-level WonGame flags; rank teams by games won; identify teams with inconsistent won flags

accepted.name: bowler_current_roster
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BowlerID,
  BowlerLastName,
  BowlerFirstName,
  BowlerMiddleInit,
  BowlerAddress,
  BowlerCity,
  BowlerState,
  BowlerZip,
  BowlerPhoneNumber,
  TeamID,
  BowlerTotalPins,
  BowlerGamesBowled,
  BowlerCurrentAverage,
  BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM Bowlers
accepted.description: Active/current bowlers with core identifying and contact info. One row per Bowler as present in Bowlers table. Useful as a stable cohort input for joins and lookups. | Use for: look up bowler contact info; join bowler roster to scores or teams; filter bowlers by team or zipcode (filter applied by query)

accepted.name: zip_city_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ZIP,
  City,
  State
FROM WAZips
accepted.description: Normalization lookup for ZIP to city and state. One row per ZIP code. Useful to enrich bowlers' BowlerZip to human-readable City/State. | Use for: map BowlerZip to city/state; geographic summaries by city or state

accepted.name: match_game_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  COUNT(*) AS games_in_match
FROM Match_Games
GROUP BY MatchID
accepted.description: Counts of games per MatchID (how many GameNumber rows exist). Useful to validate match completeness or filter matches with a specific number of games. | Use for: identify matches with incomplete games; filter matches by number of games

accepted.name: bowler_latest_average
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BowlerID,
  BowlerCurrentAverage,
  BowlerCurrentHcp,
  BowlerTotalPins,
  BowlerGamesBowled
FROM Bowlers
accepted.description: Per-bowler snapshot selecting current average and handicap from Bowlers. Although the table is already one row per bowler, this CTE exposes the canonical fields for ranking (useful when combined with score aggregates). One row per BowlerID. | Use for: rank bowlers by BowlerCurrentAverage or BowlerTotalPins; join current averages to per-game performance
